name: Akane Sumi
source:
Rin's grandmother from her father's side of the family. Sumi hasn't seen Rin since the summer she looked after Rin during Rin's childhood. She was concerned about Rin for a long time, but she fell ill and passed away. Sumi was kind to anybody, and wasn't prejudiced against ayakashi. During her lifetime, she took in Gin, a [URL=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kitsune]youko[/URL], and adopted him.

[Translation of her [URL=http://www.honeybee-cd.com/ayakashi/chara_sumi.html]official website character profile[/URL].]
